card.name: Start year before a dash or 'since'
card.fires_on: Last digit of a year that begins a range running to the present, and linking words like 'which' or 'and' after a past event where the text goes on to say it has continued since.

modes.label: Year in open range
modes.description: Final digit of a start year inside a parenthesis or range like (1952 - ....) or (1999-present).
modes.example: In our present Queen’s reign (195<<2>> - ....) the Duke of Edinburgh,

modes.label: Link to ongoing result
modes.description: A word like 'which' or 'and' after a past event, introducing something that has continued up to now.
modes.example: quite a substantial bull run,<< which>> has lasted for about two years.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'since' or 'up to now', mostly Chinese ones like 至今 and 以来.
card.plain: It fires where a start date or past event is about to be followed by 'and it has lasted until now'.
evidence: a habit of observation<< which>> has continued through all my life
